append.detail:
Seven kits (General plus the six niche doors), built to revision 2 (New World), which replaced revision 1's sixteen trade kits. lib/sites/kits/services-variants.ts, services-profile-index.ts and a test. Standalone: the theme is not registered (LIVE-2040 wires loaders, KIT_INDEX and the WebsiteTheme type). Copy follows the voice guide: sample numbers became plain statements or slot tokens, reviews are prompts, plan and shop prices are left to the owner. Each kit carries tools[] for Lane A's Spotlight doors.

2026-11-03: Daniel ruled New World is its own theme, so the six niche doors moved to New World (new-world-variants.ts, LIVE-2056). services-variants.ts keeps Services' one General template (a wrapper on the same builder) until the Services thread builds its own trade kits.
